seo.meta_title: Is Salad and Go Closed? What Happened and Who Bought It
seo.meta_description: Salad and Go closed all of its restaurants on August 5, 2026, after filing for bankruptcy. Why it closed and why many locations are becoming 7 Brew.

question: Is Salad and Go Closed?
quick_answer: Yes. Salad and Go filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and closed all of its roughly 70 remaining restaurants in Arizona and Nevada on August 5, 2026. It had already left Texas and Oklahoma earlier in 2026. In a bankruptcy auction, 7 Brew outbid Dutch Bros for dozens of the former drive-thrus, and a court approved a $123.5 million sale of 63 leases to 7 Brew, so many former Salad and Go buildings are set to become 7 Brew coffee stands.
key_facts: About 70 Arizona and Nevada locations at closing
Texas and Oklahoma stores closed in January 2026
7 Brew bought 63 former leases for $123.5 million

body.heading: What happened
body.text: On August 4, 2026, Salad and Go announced it had filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and that all of its restaurants would close for good after service on Wednesday, August 5. The closure came with almost no warning: hours before, the chain had posted about a new drink on social media. The company blamed weak consumer demand, past growth problems and rising costs, and said a July Cyclospora outbreak that it wasn't linked to had hurt confidence in salads across the industry.

body.heading: How Salad and Go shrank
body.text: Founded in Gilbert, Arizona, in 2013, Salad and Go became known for cheap, made-to-order salads and wraps sold from small drive-thrus. After private equity investors took over in 2021, it expanded fast, especially in Texas, and grew to nearly 150 locations. Then it reversed course: it closed more than 40 restaurants in Texas and Oklahoma in 2025, exited those states entirely in January 2026, and finished 2025 with about 70 locations in Arizona and Nevada.

body.heading: Who bought the Salad and Go locations
body.text: Dutch Bros first agreed to buy Salad and Go's leases for $105 million. Fellow coffee chain 7 Brew then pushed for an auction and won with a bid of about $143 million for 73 sites. In late September 2026, a bankruptcy judge approved a $123.5 million sale of 63 leases to 7 Brew's parent company: 36 in Arizona, 19 in Texas, five in Oklahoma and three in Nevada. Those small drive-thru buildings are set to be converted into 7 Brew coffee stands. Other sites were sold separately or remained unsold.

body.heading: What about Salad and Go gift cards?
body.text: Many customers were left holding gift cards and coupons when the chain closed. Because Salad and Go is in bankruptcy, there's no restaurant left to redeem them at. The company directed customers to the contact page on its website for questions.

body.heading: Where the founders went
body.text: Salad and Go's founders, Tony and Roushan Christofellis, left the company in 2021. They now run Angie's, a newer Arizona chain that also focuses on affordable food. Our Salad and Go menu page still shows the last known prices for reference, and you can see what 7 Brew serves on our 7 Brew menu page.

faqs.q: Is Salad and Go still open?
faqs.a: No. All Salad and Go restaurants closed permanently on August 5, 2026.

faqs.q: Why did Salad and Go close?
faqs.a: The company cited weak consumer demand, past growth problems and rising costs, and filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
7 Brew won approval to buy 63 former Salad and Go leases for $123.5 million, after outbidding Dutch Bros.

faqs.q: Is Salad and Go coming back?
faqs.a: There's no plan announced to reopen. Many former locations are being converted into 7 Brew coffee stands.

faqs.q: When did Salad and Go leave Texas?
faqs.a: Its last Texas and Oklahoma locations closed in January 2026.
